Series S4 (Stewardship & Governance) of the Viridis Canon — standalone record; the core IB canon spine is unchanged. The 12th Intelligence-Bound self-application (the Steersman).

Scope. Lean 4 (Aristotle-verified, zero sorry) certifies the optimization and information-geometry results, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
